root_cause: Existing commercial Heartbeat executes long Brain transaction and only calls some dispatchers. Email has separate daily cron, DM sender depends on a coupled sales-machine route, comments had an unstructured Composio mutation payload, and the connected LinkedIn toolkit has only a read/list reactions endpoint, no authenticated like mutation.
prevention_rule: Use the existing 5-minute Heartbeat as single owner of separately evidenced hourly email, approved-DM and quality-approved-comment dispatch via the original safe RPC executors. Fail one lane independently; record queued != delivered. Do not create a like until a verified provider write capability exists. Require concrete post URN/readback for structured comment mutation and preserve human approval/consent/pressure/dedupe.
